sessions.intent: Teach OBP (the Object-Based Pattern) as a language-agnostic pattern in two lessons: A the laws and rules, B the named smells

before.assumptions: The docs (object_pattern_formal.md, obp-smells.md) are the source of the pattern; every code excerpt in the lesson is quoted verbatim from plang C# or the film engine JS with path:line
before.risk: Doc examples are partly illustrative and the docs list known drift in the codebase; a lesson could present drift as the pattern, or doc pseudo-code as real code
